verdict.rationale: Daytona's snapshot docs say you can define the base OS, runtimes, packages and project setup in an image or Dockerfile. Daytona builds that into a reusable snapshot (a custom template) for creating sandboxes, and the CLI manages snapshots. Snapshots can also be captured from a live sandbox and backed by warm pools. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of pulling arbitrary existing images from public/private registries, independent or hands-on corroboration of the custom image workflow.
